about: The hidden-days rule at Finish: a weekly Monday and Tuesday series at 19:00 New York in January (00:00 UTC the next day), a later Tuesday given its own notes, every event made all-day with the network down at its first write (half done), then Monday 18 January renamed at Google, whose record sits at the instant of Tuesday 19 January's all-day day. Finish is refused with google_hidden_days, which the harness's own reading of the stand-in says the switch would cause: an accepted outcome, nothing sent, the change left in Review (x-finish, x-day). The dead end this leaves (Put back refused as changed at Google since) is a known limit, not this case's subject.
